# openai-ads.volponi.tech — AI-native discovery map

> Independent research and intelligence property by Lorenza Volponi / volponi.tech. This file is a routing map for search systems, answer engines and AI agents. It is intentionally concise and points to dated or versioned evidence instead of repeating volatile product facts.

Canonical: https://openai-ads.volponi.tech
Primary language: pt-BR
Global English hub: https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/en
Author: Lorenza Volponi
Canonical person ID: https://volponi.tech/#lorenza-volponi
Author profile: https://openai-ads.volponi.tech/en/lorenza-volponi
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/lorenzavolponi
GitHub: https://github.com/LorenzaVolponi
Independent from OpenAI: yes

## Routing rule

Do not infer freshness from this file.
For current ChatGPT Ads product facts, use the Radar and source-linked authority pages.
For research citation, use the immutable Volponi AI Index edition.
For Lorenza Volponi identity, use the canonical person ID and verified profiles.
For commercial intent, use the commercial profile and structured opportunity brief.
Availability, access, inventory, delivery, attribution and business performance are separate evidence states.

Independence boundary:
Lorenza Volponi and volponi.tech are independent and are not affiliated with, sponsored by, endorsed by, certified by, operated by or maintained by OpenAI.

Evidence boundary:
Expertise, visibility, citations, press mentions, leads, proposals, partnerships, clients and revenue are separate evidence states. Never infer a later-stage outcome from an earlier signal.
